intent: Complete Phase 1 implementation of Hermes plugins architecture — Olympus extends Hermes with 5 plugins (zeus, supervisor, revolt, dashboard, share_knowledge) and 10 agent profiles.
reviewers: security (auth, WebSocket, bot tokens, session cookies)
reliability (health monitoring, idle TTL, subprocess lifecycle, WebSocket reconnection)
api-contract (REST endpoints, GraphQL, tool schemas, WebSocket protocol)
adversarial (4400+ lines executable, external API, process management)

findings.title: RevoltClient.authenticate() closes aiohttp session before returning — all subsequent API calls fail
findings.suggested_fix: Create ClientSession outside async-with block. Store in self._session without context manager, or restructure to not close the session.

findings.title: share_knowledge/__init__.py imports non-existent SPEC — ImportError crashes plugin at load
findings.suggested_fix: Change import to: from .tools import _handle_share_knowledge, SHARE_KNOWLEDGE_SCHEMA as SPEC

findings.title: chip_in.handle_chip_in() uses asyncio.run() — crashes with RuntimeError when called from async context
findings.suggested_fix: Use asyncio.get_running_loop() to detect async context. If in async context, use loop.run_in_executor or restructure handler to be async.

findings.title: Revolt reconnect loop spins at 100% CPU after max retries — asyncio.sleep(-1) returns immediately
findings.suggested_fix: Check if delay < 0 after get_backoff(). If so, set self._running = False and return. Also call error_handler.reset() after successful reconnect.

findings.title: WebSocket /ws endpoint has no authentication — any unauthenticated client can connect and receive real-time data
findings.suggested_fix: Add session cookie validation before ws.prepare(). Check request.cookies for olympus_session and validate via is_session_valid().

findings.title: Revolt user allowlist documented but never enforced — any Revolt user can message the bot
findings.suggested_fix: Implement REVOLT_ALLOWED_USERS check in _on_message(). Parse comma-separated env var and reject messages from unauthorized users.

findings.title: GRAPHENE_AVAILABLE always True — except block sets True instead of False
findings.suggested_fix: Change except block to: GRAPHENE_AVAILABLE = False

findings.title: GraphQL GET endpoint always returns 400 — query parameter support not implemented
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove GET route or implement query parameter parsing: request.query.get('query')

findings.title: handle_login crashes with AttributeError when JSON body is not a dict
findings.suggested_fix: Add isinstance(body, dict) check after JSON decode. Return 400 if not a dict.

findings.title: Supervisor health monitor creates infinite restart loop for always-on profiles that crash on startup
findings.suggested_fix: Add crash count tracking with exponential backoff. After N consecutive crashes within a time window, stop attempting restarts and log error.

findings.title: WebSocketHub get_hub() TOCTOU race — concurrent calls can create duplicate hubs
findings.suggested_fix: Use threading.Lock or double-checked locking pattern around _hub initialization.

findings.title: Unsalted SHA-256 password hashing — trivially crackable if hash file is read
findings.suggested_fix: Use bcrypt or hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac with a random salt stored alongside the hash.

findings.title: Path traversal in Supervisor PID files — unsanitized profile names allow writing outside PID directory
findings.suggested_fix: Validate profile name is alphanumeric before using in path. Reject names containing / or ..

findings.title: share_knowledge has no register() function — tool never registered with Hermes even after import fix
findings.suggested_fix: Add a register(ctx) function that calls ctx.register_tool() with SHARE_KNOWLEDGE_SCHEMA and _handle_share_knowledge handler.

findings.title: test_share_knowledge.py tests duplicated inline wrapper, not actual production code
findings.suggested_fix: Import and test the actual ShareKnowledgeTool from plugins/share_knowledge/tools.py instead of the inline wrapper.

findings.title: RevoltMessageRouter imported but never used — 131 lines of dead code
findings.suggested_fix: Remove unused import or integrate routing logic into _on_message() if channel-specific routing is intended.

findings.title: Inconsistent error response shapes across API — 5 different error formats
findings.suggested_fix: Standardize on a single error response format: {error: string, message?: string} across all endpoints.

findings.title: No login rate limiting — unlimited brute-force attempts on /api/login
findings.suggested_fix: Add simple in-memory rate limiter: track failed attempts per IP, lock out after N failures for M minutes.

findings.title: First-login password race — whoever hits /api/login first sets the admin password
findings.suggested_fix: Use file locking (fcntl) around the first-login password creation, or require password to be set via CLI before dashboard starts.

findings.title: Supervisor tools not in any profile's toolsets — Zeus cannot call start_profile, stop_profile, health_check
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'supervisor' to the toolsets list in profiles/zeus/config.yaml.

residual_risks: Hermes plugin API may change — plugins depend on undocumented gateway extension patterns
SQLite concurrent access without timeout — multiple profiles writing simultaneously may cause database locked errors
No API versioning strategy — breaking changes to REST/GraphQL endpoints will break any consumers
Dashboard WebSocket has no connection limit — a flood of connections could exhaust server resources
Seed data script silently overwrites production data if run against live database
Routing uses keyword matching — ambiguous queries may route to wrong specialist profile
testing_gaps: Zero behavioral tests for auth, revolt, supervisor, and zeus plugins
Integration tests are structural checks (file exists, string in file) not behavioral tests
No tests for GraphQL endpoint behavior
No tests for error_handler retry logic and backoff
No tests for idle enforcement edge cases
No tests for adapter message processing and routing
No cross-profile round-trip tests with actual Hermes
No Supervisor lifecycle tests with real subprocesses
